# Blewett

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed a hundred years old (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Summons P43](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0043)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P15](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Blewett is a small woman with a shrewish face. She possesses an exceptionally lean build, lacking any superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## History

When [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brought [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Mrs. Spencer's home to address an adoption mix-up, the harsh Mrs. Blewett offered to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a domestic servant. Hesitating at the prospect of leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with her, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decided to take the girl back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P1](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P2](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P11](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P16](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0016), +9 more_
